gloss: first sunrise of the new year

definitions.gloss: first sunrise of the new year
definitions.explanation: The sunrise on January 1st. Watching it is a traditional Japanese New Year custom believed to bring good fortune.

examples.japanese: {初日|はつひ}の{出|で}を{見|み}に{行|い}く。
examples.english: To go see the first sunrise of the year.

examples.japanese: {元旦|がんたん}に{海|うみ}で{初日|はつひ}の{出|で}を{見|み}た。
examples.english: I watched the first sunrise of the year at the sea on New Year's Day.

examples.japanese: {山頂|さんちょう}から{見|み}る{初日|はつひ}の{出|で}は{格別|かくべつ}だ。
examples.english: The first sunrise seen from a mountaintop is truly special.

notes:
{初日|はつひ}の{出|で} is a traditional New Year custom in Japan.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Many people wake up early on January 1st to watch the {初日|はつひ}の{出|で} from mountains, beaches, or tall buildings. It is believed to bring good luck for the coming year.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {初日|はつひ}の{出|で}を{見|み}る: to watch the first sunrise
- {初日|はつひ}の{出|で}を{拝|おが}む: to worship/greet the first sunrise
- {初日|はつひ}の{出|で}スポット: first-sunrise viewing spot
